_id.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the migration request.

dropDestinationData.description: Flag that indicates whether the migration process drops all collections from the destination cluster before the migration starts.

links.description: List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships.

migrationHosts.description: List of migration hosts used for this migration.

Destination.description: Document that describes the destination of the migration.

clusterName.description: Label that identifies the destination cluster.

groupId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the destination project.

hostnameSchemaType.description: The network type to use between the migration host and the destination cluster.

privateLinkId.description: Represents the endpoint to use when the host schema type is `PRIVATE_LINK`.

href.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that points another API resource to which this response has some relationship. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

rel.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that defines the semantic relationship between this resource and another API resource. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

ShardEntry.description: Sharding configuration for a collection to be sharded on the destination cluster.

collection.description: Human-readable label that identifies the collection to be sharded on the destination cluster.

database.description: Human-readable label that identifies the database that contains the collection to be sharded on the destination cluster.

ShardKeys.description: Document that configures the shard key on the destination cluster.

key.description: List of fields to use for the shard key.

ShardingRequest.description: Document that configures sharding on the destination cluster when migrating from a replica set source to a sharded cluster destination on MongoDB 6.0 or higher. If you don't wish to shard any collections on the destination cluster, leave this empty.

createSupportingIndexes.description: Flag that lets the migration create supporting indexes for the shard keys, if none exists, as the destination cluster also needs compatible indexes for the specified shard keys.

shardingEntries.description: List of shard configurations to shard destination collections. Atlas shards only those collections that you include in the sharding entries array.

Source.description: Document that describes the source of the migration.

caCertificatePath.description: Path to the CA certificate that signed SSL certificates use to authenticate to the source cluster.

clusterName.description: Label that identifies the source cluster name.

groupId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the source project.

managedAuthentication.description: Flag that indicates whether MongoDB Automation manages authentication to the source cluster. If true, do not provide values for username and password.

password.description: Password that authenticates the username to the source cluster.

ssl.description: Flag that indicates whether you have SSL enabled.

username.description: Label that identifies the SCRAM-SHA user that connects to the source cluster.
